capabilities.descriptionEn: Applies the current schema and provides the durable product data store.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Áp dụng schema hiện tại và cung cấp kho dữ liệu bền vững cho sản phẩm.

capabilities.descriptionEn: Provides the Data API, authentication, server administration and browser client.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Cung cấp Data API, xác thực, quản trị phía server và client trình duyệt.

capabilities.nameVi: Bảo mật thiết lập lần đầu
capabilities.descriptionEn: Protects one-time owner creation and permanently locks setup after completion.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Bảo vệ việc tạo chủ sở hữu lần đầu và khóa thiết lập vĩnh viễn sau khi hoàn tất.

capabilities.descriptionEn: Defines the application origin, bind address, runtime mode and session signing.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Xác định origin, địa chỉ lắng nghe, chế độ chạy và chữ ký phiên của ứng dụng.

capabilities.descriptionEn: Stores private avatars, attachments, branding, exports and other product files.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Lưu avatar, tệp đính kèm, thương hiệu, bản xuất và các tệp sản phẩm ở chế độ riêng tư.

capabilities.descriptionEn: Delivers live inbox, notification and workflow updates through Supabase Realtime.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Cung cấp cập nhật trực tiếp cho Hộp thư, thông báo và quy trình qua Supabase Realtime.

capabilities.nameVi: Khởi tạo Tổ chức & Không gian làm việc
capabilities.descriptionEn: Creates the first organization, workspace and owner memberships without changing tenant ownership rules.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Tạo Tổ chức, Không gian làm việc và quyền sở hữu ban đầu mà không thay đổi quy tắc tenant.

capabilities.descriptionEn: Runs workspace APIs, signed webhook dispatch and provider callbacks.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Vận hành API theo Không gian làm việc, điều phối webhook có chữ ký và callback nhà cung cấp.

capabilities.descriptionEn: Protects scheduled jobs for workflows, reminders, billing and provider synchronization.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Bảo vệ tác vụ lịch cho quy trình, nhắc việc, thanh toán và đồng bộ nhà cung cấp.

capabilities.descriptionEn: Signs live-chat and embedded widget sessions.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Ký phiên cho live chat và tiện ích nhúng.

capabilities.nameVi: Plugin & danh mục nhà cung cấp
capabilities.descriptionEn: Provides the installed plugin, marketplace and provider registry surfaces already present in the product.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Cung cấp các màn hình plugin đã cài, marketplace và danh mục nhà cung cấp hiện có trong sản phẩm.

capabilities.descriptionEn: Enables AI assistance, chat, embeddings, analytics and automation through implemented providers.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Bật trợ lý AI, chat, embedding, phân tích và tự động hóa qua các nhà cung cấp đã triển khai.

capabilities.descriptionEn: Connects WhatsApp Business accounts, webhooks, forms, templates and messaging APIs.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Kết nối tài khoản WhatsApp Business, webhook, biểu mẫu, mẫu tin nhắn và API nhắn tin.

capabilities.descriptionEn: Links and manages WhatsApp devices through the separate signed QR worker.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Liên kết và quản lý thiết bị WhatsApp qua QR worker độc lập có chữ ký.

capabilities.descriptionEn: Supplies the shared Meta application identity, OAuth and webhook verification.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Cung cấp định danh ứng dụng Meta dùng chung, OAuth và xác minh webhook.

capabilities.descriptionEn: Connects Facebook Pages and Messenger chatbot conversations to the Inbox.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Kết nối Trang Facebook và hội thoại chatbot Messenger vào Hộp thư.

capabilities.descriptionEn: Connects professional accounts, direct-message chatbots and comment automation.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Kết nối tài khoản chuyên nghiệp, chatbot tin nhắn trực tiếp và tự động hóa bình luận.

capabilities.descriptionEn: Connects Telegram bots and routes chats into the Inbox.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Kết nối bot Telegram và chuyển hội thoại vào Hộp thư.

capabilities.descriptionEn: Connects email sender identities and receives managed email delivery events.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Kết nối định danh người gửi email và nhận sự kiện chuyển phát email được quản lý.

capabilities.descriptionEn: Connects SMS numbers and verifies inbound Twilio webhooks.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Kết nối số SMS và xác minh webhook Twilio đến.

capabilities.descriptionEn: Provides the implemented Stripe billing adapter and signed webhook processing.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Cung cấp adapter thanh toán Stripe đã triển khai và xử lý webhook có chữ ký.

capabilities.descriptionEn: Provides the implemented Paddle billing adapter and signed webhook processing.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Cung cấp adapter thanh toán Paddle đã triển khai và xử lý webhook có chữ ký.

capabilities.descriptionEn: Starts Google Calendar and Microsoft Outlook OAuth through the existing App User Connector.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Khởi tạo OAuth Google Calendar và Microsoft Outlook qua App User Connector hiện có.

capabilities.descriptionEn: Offers the current database-configured OAuth, API-key and webhook integrations after setup.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Cung cấp các tích hợp OAuth, API key và webhook hiện tại được cấu hình trong cơ sở dữ liệu sau thiết lập.

capabilities.descriptionEn: Checks public/server separation, production origin, container health and build/runtime settings for a future Coolify deployment.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Kiểm tra tách biệt public/server, origin production, health container và cấu hình build/runtime cho triển khai Coolify sau này.

capabilities.descriptionEn: Describes the isolated local Supabase, application and Docker-assisted workflow.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Mô tả quy trình Supabase local cô lập, ứng dụng và Docker.

capabilities.nameVi: Bộ kiểm thử RLS tự động
capabilities.descriptionEn: Creates generated test tenants only when explicitly invoked and supports teardown.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Chỉ tạo tenant kiểm thử ngẫu nhiên khi được gọi rõ ràng và hỗ trợ dọn dẹp.

capabilities.descriptionEn: Controls browser tests, database audits and CI summaries outside normal product startup.
capabilities.descriptionVi: Điều khiển kiểm thử trình duyệt, audit cơ sở dữ liệu và báo cáo CI ngoài quá trình khởi động sản phẩm.

variables.nameVi: URL kết nối cơ sở dữ liệu
variables.purpose: Direct PostgreSQL connection used by the Product migration runner.
variables.enabledWhen: Always for Product startup and setup validation.

variables.purpose: Server-side Data API, Auth, Storage and readiness endpoint base URL.
Public-scope key used by authenticated server clients and public Data API probes.
Privileged server-only administration for setup, webhooks and trusted jobs.
variables.validation: Non-empty server secret; must never use VITE_ prefix.

variables.purpose: Browser-visible Supabase endpoint baked into the web bundle.
variables.validation: Absolute HTTP(S) URL; production must not use localhost.

variables.nameVi: Khóa publishable Supabase cho trình duyệt
variables.purpose: Browser-visible publishable key baked into the web bundle.
variables.validation: Non-empty publishable/anon key; never a service-role key.

variables.purpose: Canonical application origin for secure redirects, CORS and deployment checks.
variables.validation: Origin-only absolute HTTP(S) URL; production must use HTTPS and not localhost.

variables.purpose: Signs/encrypts server state and provides a last-resort token-encryption key.
Authorizes the one-time first-run setup session on the server.
variables.enabledWhen: Until setup completes; retain for controlled deployment consistency.

variables.purpose: Selects development or production runtime safeguards.
variables.enabledWhen: Set by runtime/container; production value is production.

variables.purpose: Network interface used by the Node app or QR worker.
Listening port for the Node app, tests or QR worker.
variables.enabledWhen: Runtime supplies a port or defaults are used.

variables.purpose: Fallback port for the inherited cPanel Passenger launcher.
Controls application and QR-worker logging verbosity.
Stamps the image and public health response.
Adds the deployed commit identifier to the health response.
variables.validation: Git commit identifier or release reference.

variables.purpose: Build-time base path for generated assets.
variables.enabledWhen: Only when mounted below the domain root.

variables.purpose: Browser-visible development, staging or production label.
Optional build-time fallback name for static contexts.
variables.enabledWhen: Optional white-label build; platform branding remains configurable after setup.

variables.nameVi: URL gốc tài liệu công khai
variables.purpose: Optional operator-owned base URL for externally hosted static documentation.
variables.enabledWhen: External documentation is published for this deployment.
variables.validation: Absolute HTTPS URL without a trailing slash.

variables.purpose: Enables browser-side count diagnostics.
Controls verbose browser-visible audit diagnostics.
Selects the Node-compatible Nitro build output.
Alternative build selector for Node middleware/server output.
Controls Docker Compose replica count.

variables.nameVi: Biến phiên bản image kế thừa
variables.purpose: Selects the inherited Docker image tag and build version.
Authenticates scheduled internal job endpoints.
variables.enabledWhen: Any external scheduler calls internal hooks.

variables.purpose: Authenticates the public webhook dispatch endpoint.
Signs and verifies client-widget sessions.
variables.enabledWhen: Client widgets or live chat are enabled.

variables.purpose: Encrypts App User Connector and provider connection keys.
Runs inherited AI features and verifies managed email events.
variables.enabledWhen: Lovable AI or managed email events are enabled.

variables.purpose: Credential suggested and resolved by the implemented OpenAI provider.
Credential suggested and resolved by the implemented Anthropic provider.
Credential suggested and resolved by the implemented Gemini provider.
Credential suggested and dynamically resolved by the implemented DeepSeek-compatible provider.
Credential suggested and dynamically resolved by the implemented Grok-compatible provider.
Credential suggested and dynamically resolved by the implemented OpenRouter-compatible provider.
Default secret name for the custom OpenAI-compatible provider.

variables.nameVi: URL cơ sở Ollama nền tảng
variables.purpose: Operator-controlled internal OpenAI-compatible URL for the shared self-hosted Ollama utility service. Required in production; local development may fall back to localhost.
variables.enabledWhen: Platform-managed local utility AI (Ollama) is enabled.
variables.validation: Absolute HTTP URL to the internal Ollama OpenAI-compatible endpoint; production must not use localhost.

variables.nameVi: Mô hình tiện ích Ollama nền tảng
variables.purpose: Default chat model id used when seeding conversation_intelligence onto the platform-managed Ollama provider.
variables.enabledWhen: Platform-managed local utility AI is provisioned.
variables.validation: Non-empty Ollama model id already available on the operator Ollama service.

variables.nameVi: Khóa mã hóa thông tin AI
variables.purpose: Operator master key that encrypts workspace BYOK API keys at rest. Not a customer API key. Required only when a workspace saves or uses an encrypted provider credential.
variables.enabledWhen: Workspace BYOK provider credentials are saved or decrypted.

variables.nameVi: Kho vector cơ sở tri thức
variables.purpose: Selects the implemented knowledge-base vector-store backend.
variables.enabledWhen: Knowledge-base RAG is used; defaults to pgvector.
variables.validation: pgvector or another implemented factory key.

variables.purpose: Fallback credential for WhatsApp Cloud sending, templates, forms and catalog operations.
variables.enabledWhen: WhatsApp Cloud is enabled without a per-account secret name.
variables.validation: Non-empty Meta System User access token.

variables.purpose: Fallback HMAC secret for WhatsApp webhook signature verification.
variables.enabledWhen: WhatsApp Cloud webhook verification uses the conventional secret name.

variables.purpose: Optional environment fallback for WhatsApp Flow operations.
variables.enabledWhen: Flows use global fallback instead of an account record.

variables.purpose: Optional environment fallback for WhatsApp Flow operations.
variables.enabledWhen: Flows use global fallback instead of an account record.

variables.purpose: Supported fallback alias for WhatsApp/Meta token resolution.
variables.enabledWhen: Provider records use the Meta alias.

variables.purpose: Starts Messenger/Instagram OAuth and identifies the Meta application.
Exchanges OAuth codes and verifies Messenger/Instagram webhook signatures.

variables.nameVi: Verify token webhook Meta dùng chung
variables.purpose: Shared fallback token for Messenger/Instagram webhook subscription verification.
variables.enabledWhen: A channel-specific verify token is not configured.

variables.purpose: Channel-specific token for Messenger webhook subscription verification.
Channel-specific token for Instagram webhook subscription verification.
Preferred key for encrypting Instagram/Meta connection tokens.
Base URL used by the app to call the separate QR worker.
variables.validation: Absolute HTTP(S) URL; production must not use localhost.

variables.purpose: Bearer token for app-to-worker authorization.
variables.validation: At least 32 random characters; identical on app and worker.

variables.purpose: Signs app-to-worker requests.
variables.validation: At least 32 random characters; identical on app and worker.

variables.purpose: Signs worker-to-app webhook events.
variables.validation: At least 32 random characters; identical on app and worker.

variables.purpose: Worker destination for signed QR events; inherited variable name remains active.
Persistent filesystem directory for QR worker device credentials.
Fallback bot token when connecting a Telegram account.
variables.enabledWhen: Telegram bot integration is enabled without entering a token in the connection flow.

variables.purpose: Verifies signatures on inbound Twilio SMS webhooks.
Used only by the inherited optimization report to signal external SMTP readiness.
variables.enabledWhen: An external SMTP deployment convention is used.
variables.validation: Hostname; no SMTP transport currently reads it directly.

variables.purpose: Authenticates implemented Stripe REST API operations.
Verifies Stripe billing webhook signatures.
Authenticates implemented Paddle REST API operations.
Selects Paddle sandbox or live API.
variables.validation: sandbox or live; code treats live specially and defaults otherwise to sandbox.

variables.purpose: Verifies Paddle billing webhook signatures.
Starts Google Calendar OAuth through the existing connector gateway.
variables.validation: Non-empty App User Connector client API key.

variables.purpose: Starts Microsoft Outlook OAuth through the existing connector gateway.
variables.validation: Non-empty App User Connector client API key.

variables.purpose: Pins local CLI operations to the isolated vmoaimartech-local project.
variables.enabledWhen: Local launchers and env generation only.
variables.validation: Must equal vmoaimartech-local in repository launchers.

variables.nameEn: Legacy local public project ID override
variables.nameVi: Override ID dự án public local kế thừa
variables.purpose: Neutralizes an inherited ignored .env placeholder during local CLI startup; the web app does not read it.
Disables Supabase CLI telemetry for deterministic local tooling.
Explicitly enables and authenticates the public RLS test harness.
variables.enabledWhen: Only during an intentional RLS test run.
variables.validation: Strong random secret; omit to disable harness.

variables.nameVi: Override production cho bộ kiểm thử RLS
variables.purpose: Dangerous explicit override allowing the test harness in NODE_ENV=production.
variables.enabledWhen: Controlled staging drill only; never normal production.

variables.purpose: Points Playwright at an existing environment instead of starting local Vite.
Enables CI retries, worker limits and strict test behavior.
Enables engineering scripts that call psql for database audits.
variables.enabledWhen: Database audit scripts run with psql.

variables.nameVi: Đường dẫn báo cáo GitHub Actions
variables.purpose: Writes audit summaries into GitHub Actions job output.
variables.validation: Writable file path supplied by GitHub.
